content.short: Clovis is a cross-chain yield aggregator letting users deposit from one chain and earn on another.
content.description: Clovis, built by the Yei Finance team, accepts a deposit on one chain and puts it to work in strategies on another, so the user is not required to bridge before earning. Hiding the bridge inside the deposit is convenient and also means the bridge risk is now something the protocol is taking on the user's behalf.
content.meta: Deposit on one chain and earn on another, with the bridging step absorbed by the protocol.
